A bill for an act relating to education; providing for a grant for learning with music; appropriating money.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. [+APPROPRIATION; MACPHAIL CENTER FOR MUSIC. +]

[+Subdivision 1.+]

[+Department of Education.+]

[+The sums indicated in this section are appropriated from the general fund to the Department of Education in the fiscal years designated. +]

[+Subd. 2.+]

[+MacPhail Center for Music.+]

[+(a) For a grant to the MacPhail Center for Music to expand the Learning with Music program: +]

[+$ +]

[+250,000 +]

[+$ +]

[+250,000 +]

[+..... +]

[+2027 +]

[+(b) The grant recipient must use grant money received under this section to: +]

[+(1) create and deliver professional development training opportunities to early childhood educators statewide, both online and in person, that are based on the research-backed successful elements of the Learning with Music program; and +]

bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to education; providing for a grant for learning with music; appropriating money.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATION; MACPHAIL CENTER FOR MUSIC.

Subdivision 1.

Department of Education.

The sums indicated in this section are appropriated from the general fund to the Department of Education in the fiscal years designated.

Subd. 2.

MacPhail Center for Music.

(a) For a grant to the MacPhail Center for Music to expand the Learning with Music program:

$

250,000

.....

2026

$

250,000

.....

2027

(b) The grant recipient must use grant money received under this section to:

(1) create and deliver professional development training opportunities to early childhood educators statewide, both online and in person, that are based on the research-backed successful elements of the Learning with Music program; and

(2) deepen direct programming to five early childhood center locations to serve as the model for program expansion, with a focus on meeting the needs of children experiencing economic hardship in the Twin Cities metropolitan area.

(b) The grant recipient must use grant money received under this section to:

(2) deepen direct programming to five early childhood center locations to serve as the model for program expansion, with a focus on meeting the needs of children experiencing economic hardship in the Twin Cities metropolitan area.
